_readme: House variations for the base's growing city (one building appears per player growth stage). These are the Fab house models, optimized from ~90MB raw exports to <1.2MB each (mesh simplify error 1%, 512px WebP textures, quantized attributes) via @gltf-transform/cli. To add more: drop a .glb/.gltf/.fbx here and append its path. Only list files that actually exist. `base` is a dedicated model for the Command Center's tier-1 ("Base Camp") appearance, used before any growth-stage buildings/districts are added — NOT part of the sprawl-building `houses` pool. `house_dessert_outpost.glb` is a dedicated desert-outpost marker (see FbxProps.DESERT_OUTPOST_ASSET), not a sprawl building. 2026-07-18: the original 14-house batch (house_01..house_16) was RETIRED per user request ("remove the old houses, only keep and use the new ones") — `houses` now lists only the newer set (house_17-19 + trading_post).
